content: Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 80% in each subject to be eligible for semester examinations.
Students with medical emergencies must submit valid medical certificates to the academic department.
Students can borrow a maximum of 4 books at a time using their college identity card.
The college library operates from 9 AM to 5 PM, Monday through Saturday.
Books must be returned within 14 days. Late returns may result in a fine.
Applicants must submit academic transcripts, identity proof, and completed application forms during admission.
Admission confirmation is provided after document verification and payment of the applicable admission fee.
Students must maintain a minimum CGPA of 7.0 to participate in campus placement activities.
The placement department organizes aptitude training, technical workshops, and mock interviews.
Students must carry their college identity cards and examination hall tickets to enter the examination hall.
Students must arrive at the examination hall at least 15 minutes before the scheduled examination time.
Students can pay their semester fees through the college payment portal before the announced deadline.
